why: Caps that neither block nor ask: the run proceeds and the action is still `proceed`, but the ceiling bounds what the result may claim. This is the state the guide is in for most of a generated walkthrough, and it is the one most easily broken into either neighbour - promote an advisory cap to blocking and a healthy run stops; demote a blocking one and an invalid evaluator runs. Built from the material `partial-missing-dataset` already commits.
